headline: The two-hour unfreeze, built while main stayed red
lede: Slot b verified VIPER PIT top to bottom and shipped Jon's steer #2176 — the rule and mechanism that keep a red main from ever freezing the factory for a day again. Both PRs are green and parked on the one freeze they exist to break.

notes.text: VIPER PIT #2172 verified 388/388 (pose-per-card, computed framing, contained zoom, five DISTINCT faces under the shared-canvas fix) — PR #2174 static-green and merge-ready.

Main stayed frozen all shift: nightly 43443192812 reds on the fire-crew resume soft-lock whose fix (#2181, slot a) is itself parked behind the freeze — question #2184 asks Jon to land the unfreeze directly, #2170-style.

Rule 5a landed in PR #2186: red main clears within 2 h; harness-only fixes need no permission (jonq now refuses them); a stubborn check gets quarantined by naming an open issue, and NIGHTLY GREEN can never read silently green.
